verdict.rationale: Omarchy is documented and used as a full bootable Linux distribution (dual-boot, full-disk install, replacing the host OS) rather than as a terminal environment run inside another host OS (e.g., WSL-style). The evidence pack shows install/dual-boot options (omarchy-docs-13, omarchy-docs-14) and even running Windows inside Omarchy via Docker VM (omarchy-docs-12), but nothing supporting the reverse use case of running Omarchy's Linux environment inside another host OS for dev tooling.
